description: Get Swiss population data from the Federal Statistical Office (FSO/BFS). Returns population figures for Switzerland, a canton, or all cantons. Data source: BFS STATPOP (permanent resident population).

canton.description: Canton name or 2-letter code (e.g. 'ZH', 'Zürich', 'Geneva', 'BE'). Omit to get Switzerland total. Use 'all' to list all cantons.

year.description: Year of data (2010–2024). Defaults to latest (2024).

name: get_population
